entries: Immediately after you take the {@action Attack} action and attack with a {@item Quarterstaff}, a {@item Spear}, or a weapon that has the Heavy and Reach properties, you can use a {@rule Bonus Action} to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. The weapon deals Bludgeoning damage, and the weapon's damage die for this attack is a {@damage d4}.

entries.name: Reactive Strike
entries: While you're holding a {@item Quarterstaff}, a {@item Spear}, or a weapon that has the Heavy and Reach properties, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to make one melee attack against a creature that enters the reach you have with that weapon.

name: Portal Jumper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Otherworldly Resilience
entries: You have {@rule Resistance} to one of the following damage types: Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Portal Step
entries: You can spend 15 feet of movement to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of yourself. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} but only once per turn, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Prodigy
entries: You have a knack for learning new things. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain one skill proficiency of your choice, one tool proficiency of your choice, and fluency in one language of your choice.

Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it. The skill you choose must be one that isn't already benefiting from a feature, such as Expertise, that doubles your proficiency bonus.

name: Purple Dragon Commandant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Encourage Ally
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you bolster one ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally gains {@rule Temporary Hit Points} equal to {@dice 2d6} plus the modifier of the ability score increased by this feat. You can take this {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls while {@status Bloodied}.

name: Purple Dragon Rook
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Entreat
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Insight}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion}.

entries.name: Rallying Cry
entries: When you roll {@rule Initiative} and don't have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} that you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Those creatures gain {@rule Heroic Inspiration}.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Putrefy
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Necrosis
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Necrotic damage, you can cause one creature taking that damage to have the {@condition Poisoned} condition until the start of your next turn. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Rebuke
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Radiant Strike
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, you can cause one Huge or smaller creature taking the damage to have the {@condition Prone} condition. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Resilient

choose.entry: Choose one ability in which you lack saving throw proficiency. Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Saving Throw Proficiency
entries: You gain saving throw proficiency with the chosen ability.

name: Revenant Blade
entries: You are descended from a master of the {@item double-bladed scimitar}, and some of that mastery has passed on to you. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are holding a double-bladed scimitar with two hands, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
A double-bladed scimitar has the finesse property when you wield it.

name: Righteous Heritor
entries: You can channel cosmic forces of good to gain these benefits:

items.name: Soothe Pain
entries: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by {@dice 1d10} + your proficiency bonus. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Ritual Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ritual Spells
entries: Choose a number of level 1 spells equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} that have the Ritual tag. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Whenever your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} increases thereafter, you can add an additional level 1 spell with the {@rule Ritual} tag to the spells always prepared with this feature.

entries.name: Quick Ritual
entries: With this benefit, you can cast a {@rule Ritual} spell that you have prepared using its regular casting time rather than the extended time for a {@rule Ritual}. Doing so doesn't require a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't use this benefit again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Rune Shaper
entries: You've studied the magic of Giant runes, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Comprehend Languages
entries: You learn the {@spell comprehend languages} spell. You can cast this spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have.

items.name: Rune Magic
entries: You know a number of runes equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down), chosen from the Rune Spells table. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can inscribe each rune you know onto one nonmagical weapon, armor, piece of clothing, or other object you touch. You temporarily learn the 1st-level spells that correspond to the runes you inscribed, as specified on the Rune Spells table, and you know those spells until you finish a long rest, when the runes fade. While you are wearing or carrying any rune-marked object, you can cast the spells associated with those runes using any spell slots you have.

You can also invoke a rune inscribed on an object you are wearing or carrying and cast its associated spell without expending a spell slot or using material components. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Your spellcasting ability for this feat is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
Each time you gain a level, you can replace one of the runes you know with another one from the Rune Spells table.

name: Savage Attacker
entries: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

name: Scion of the Outer Planes
entries: Your connection to an Outer Plane infuses you with the energy there. Choose a type of plane listed in the Planar Infusion table. Your choice gives you resistance to a damage type and the ability to cast a cantrip, as specified in the table. You can cast this cantrip without material components, and your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

name: Second Chance
entries: Fortune favors you when someone tries to strike you. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force that creature to reroll. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you roll initiative at the start of combat or until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Sentinel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Guardian
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the {@action Disengage} action or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack} against that creature.

entries.name: Halt
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@action Opportunity Attack}, the creature's {@rule Speed} becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.

name: Shadow-Touched
entries: Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic grants you the following benefits.

entries.name: Shadow Magic
entries: Choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school of magic. You always have that spell and the {@spell Invisibility} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Shadowmoor Hexer
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hex
entries: You always have the {@spell Hex} spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Curse Magic
entries: When a creature that you've cursed with {@spell Hex} hits you with an attack roll, the creature takes Psychic damage equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

name: Sharp Eye
entries: When you take the {@action Search} or {@action Study} action, you can give yourself {@rule Advantage} on any ability check made as part of that action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. If the check fails, the use of this feature isn't expended.

name: Sharpshooter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bypass Cover
entries: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore {@rule Cover|Half Cover} and {@rule Cover|Three-Quarters Cover}.

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Long Shots
entries: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

name: Shield Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries: If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the {@action Attack} action and hit with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your {@item Shield} if it's equipped, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Strength modifier and {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, you either push the target 5 feet from you or cause it to have the {@condition Prone} condition (your choice). You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

entries.name: Interpose Shield
entries: If you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and are holding a {@item Shield}.

name: Skill Expert
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Skill Proficiency
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Expertise
entries: Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack {@rule Expertise}. You gain {@rule Expertise} with that skill.

name: Skilled
entries: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Skulker
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Blindsight
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight} with a range of 10 feet.

entries.name: Fog of War
entries: You exploit the distractions of battle, gaining {@rule Advantage} on any Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check you make as part of the {@action Hide} action during combat.

entries.name: Sniper
entries: If you make an attack roll while hidden and the roll misses, making the attack roll doesn't reveal your location.

name: Slasher
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hamstring
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Slashing damage, you can reduce the {@rule Speed} of that creature by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Enhanced Critical
entries: When you score a {@rule Critical Hit} that deals Slashing damage to a creature, it has {@rule Disadvantage} on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

name: Soothing Familiar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Healing Beacon
entries: Positive energy fills a 5-foot {@rule Emanation [Area of Effect]|Emanation} originating from your familiar as long as it is within 120 feet of you. Whenever an ally in that {@rule Emanation [Area of Effect]|Emanation} rolls a die to determine the number of {@rule Hit Points} restored to a creature, that ally can treat a roll of 1 or 2 on the die as a 3.

name: Soul of the Storm Giant
entries: You've manifested the tempest magic emblematic of storm giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Maelstrom Aura
entries: As a bonus action, you surround yourself with an aura of magical wind and lightning that extends 10 feet from you in every direction but not through total cover. The aura lasts until the start of your next turn or until you are incapacitated. While the aura is active, you have resistance to lightning and thunder damage. In addition, attack rolls against you have disadvantage, and whenever another creature starts its turn within the aura, you can force the creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature's speed is halved until the start of its next turn. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Speedy
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Speed Increase
entries: Your {@rule Speed} increases by 10 feet.

entries.name: Dash over Difficult Terrain
entries: When you take the {@action Dash} action on your turn, {@rule Difficult Terrain} doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn.

entries.name: Agile Movement
entries: {@action Opportunity Attack|Opportunity Attacks} have {@rule Disadvantage} against you.

name: Spell Resistant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magical Resilience
entries: You have {@rule Resistance} to one of the following damage types (choose when you gain this feat): Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder.

entries.name: Magic Resistant
entries: When you would fail a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the save's total, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Spell Sniper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bypass Cover
entries: Your attack rolls for spells ignore {@rule Cover|Half Cover} and {@rule Cover|Three-Quarters Cover}.

entries.name: Casting in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your attack rolls with spells.

entries.name: Increased Range
entries: When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell's range by 60 feet.

name: Spell Subterfuge
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shrouding Spells
entries: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action using a spell slot, you can take both the {@action Dash} and {@action Hide} actions as a {@rule Bonus Action}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Sneaky Casting
entries: If you have the {@action Hide} action's {@condition Invisible} condition, casting a spell with a Verbal component or making a spell attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind {@rule Cover|Three-Quarters Cover} or {@rule Cover|Total Cover}.

name: Spellfire Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fueled Spellfire
entries: Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant damage, you can expend up to two {@rule Hit Point Dice}, roll them, and add the total rolled to one damage roll of the spell.

entries.name: Searing Spellfire
entries: When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, it ignores {@rule Resistance} to Radiant damage.

name: Spellfire Spark
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magic Absorption
entries: Once per turn, when you take damage from a spell or magical effect, you reduce the total damage taken by {@dice 1d4}. You can't use this benefit if you have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

entries.name: Spellfire Flame
entries: You learn the {@spell Sacred Flame} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can also cast this cantrip as a {@rule Bonus Action} a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Squat Nimbleness
entries: You are uncommonly nimble for your race. You gain the following benefits:

items: Increase your walking speed by 5 feet.
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Acrobatics} or {@skill Athletics} skill (your choice).
You have advantage on any Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check you make to escape from being {@condition grappled}.

name: Squire of Solamnia
entries: Your training in the ways of the Knights of Solamnia grants you these benefits:

items.name: Mount Up
entries: Mounting or dismounting costs you only 5 feet of movement.

items.name: Precise Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you make a weapon attack roll against a creature, you can cause the attack roll to have advantage. If the attack hits, you roll a {@damage d8} and add the number rolled as a bonus to the attack's damage roll. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, but a use is expended only if the attack hits. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Membership in Knightly Orders
entries: Knights of Solamnia are only ever members of one of their organization's orders. In the course of their training, most knights begin as members of the Knights of the Crown and then move on to join other orders. Whether a character follows this path or another, they retain what they learned as a member of an order even if they join another. Characters can change what knightly order they're a part of, but they always have access to any Knight of Solamnia feats they've acquired.

name: Stagger and Sway
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defer Damage
entries: When you take damage, reduce the damage you take by your Dexterity modifier (minimum of 1). Then add a {@damage d6} to your Delayed Reaction pool. At the end of your turn, remove all the dice from your Delayed Reaction pool and roll them. You take Force damage equal to the total rolled.

entries.name: Purify
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can remove a number of dice equal to your Wisdom modifier from your Delayed Reaction pool.

name: Street Justice
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Headlock
entries: Your allies have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls against a creature {@condition Grappled} by you.

entries.name: Sturdy Knot
entries: When you use {@item Chain}, {@item Manacles}, or {@item Rope} to bind a creature, add your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus} to the DC to escape or burst the {@item Chain}, {@item Manacles}, or {@item Rope}.

entries.name: Tough Talk
entries: A creature's {@rule Hostile [Attitude]|Hostile} attitude doesn't impose {@rule Disadvantage} on your Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks to influence that creature.

name: Strike of the Giants
entries: You have absorbed primeval magic that gives you an echo of the might of giants. When you take this feat, choose one of the benefits listed below. Once per turn, when you hit a target with a melee weapon attack or a ranged weapon attack using a thrown weapon, you can imbue the attack with an additional effect depending on the benefit you chose:

entries.name: Cloud Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} thunder damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or you become invisible to it until the start of your next turn or until immediately after you make an attack roll or cast a spell.

entries.name: Fire Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} fire damage.

entries.name: Frost Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Hill Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the weapon's type. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

entries.name: Stone Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet from you in a straight line.

entries.name: Storm Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
The saving throw DC for these effects equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Constitution modifier.
You can use this feat a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

name: Strixhaven Initiate
entries: You have studied some magical theory and have learned a few spells associated with Strixhaven University.

Choose one of Strixhaven's colleges: Lorehold, Prismari, Quandrix, Silverquill, or Witherbloom. You learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell based on the college you choose, as specified in the Strixhaven Spells table.
You can cast the chosen 1st-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

entries.caption: Strixhaven Spells
rows: Choose two from {@spell light}, {@spell sacred flame}, and {@spell thaumaturgy}.
Choose one 1st-level cleric or wizard spell.
Choose two from {@spell fire bolt}, {@spell prestidigitation}, and {@spell ray of frost}.
Choose one 1st-level bard or sorcerer spell.
Choose two from {@spell druidcraft}, {@spell guidance}, and {@spell mage hand}.
Choose one 1st-level druid or wizard spell.
Choose two from {@spell sacred flame}, {@spell thaumaturgy}, and {@spell vicious mockery}.
Choose one 1st-level bard or cleric spell.
Choose two from {@spell chill touch}, {@spell druidcraft}, and {@spell spare the dying}.
Choose one 1st-level druid or wizard spell.

name: Strixhaven Mascot
entries: You have learned how to summon a Strixhaven mascot to assist you, granting you these benefits:

items: You can cast the {@spell find familiar} spell as a ritual. Your familiar can take the form of the mascot associated with the college you chose for the Strixhaven Initiate feat: a {@creature spirit statue mascot} (Lorehold), an {@creature art elemental mascot} (Prismari), a {@creature fractal mascot} (Quandrix), an {@creature inkling mascot} (Silverquill), or a {@creature pest mascot} (Witherbloom).
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can forgo one attack to allow your mascot familiar to make one attack of its own with its reaction.

If your mascot familiar is within 60 feet of you, you can teleport as an action, swapping places with the familiar. If your destination space is too small for you to occupy, the teleportation fails and is wasted. Once you teleport in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher to do it again.

name: Survivor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Hypervigilance
entries: Whenever you roll {@rule Initiative}, you can reroll the {@dice d20} if the number rolled is 9 or lower. You must use the new roll.

entries.name: Steel Yourself
entries: When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed} or {@condition Frightened} condition, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to add a bonus to the roll, potentially causing it to succeed. The bonus is equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.
Once you take this {@rule Reaction}, you can't do so again until you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Svirfneblin Magic
entries: You have inherited the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors. This ability allows you to cast {@spell nondetection} on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast each of the following spells once with this ability: {@spell blindness/deafness}, {@spell blur}, and {@spell disguise self}. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a long rest.
Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and you cast them at their lowest possible levels.

name: Tavern Brawler
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enhanced Unarmed Strike
entries: When you hit with your {@rule Unarmed Strike} and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 1d4} plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an {@rule Unarmed Strike}.

entries.name: Damage Rerolls
entries: Whenever you roll a damage die for your {@rule Unarmed Strike}, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Improvised Weaponry
entries: You have proficiency with improvised weapons.

entries.name: Push
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@rule Unarmed Strike} as part of the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can deal damage to the target and also push it 5 feet away from you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

name: Telekinetic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Minor Telekinesis
entries: You learn the {@spell Mage Hand} spell. You can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, you can make the spectral hand {@condition Invisible}, and its range and the distance it can be away from you both increase by 30 feet when you cast it. The spell's spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Telekinetic Shove
entries: As a {@rule Bonus Action}, you can telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}) or be moved 5 feet toward or away from you.

name: Telepathic
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Telepathic Utterance
entries: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn't give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically.

entries.name: Detect Thoughts
entries: You always have the {@spell Detect Thoughts} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot or spell components, and you must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Tireless Reveler
entries: When an ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself expends {@rule Heroic Inspiration}, you can gain {@rule Heroic Inspiration} if you lack it. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Tough
entries: Your {@rule Hit Points|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your {@rule Hit Points|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 2 {@rule Hit Points}.

name: Transmutation Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Transmutation Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Magical Augmentation
entries: On your turn when you cast a spell from the Transmutation school using a spell slot, your {@rule Speed} increases by a number of feet equal to five times the level of spell slot expended. This increase lasts until the end of the turn.

name: Transmuted Anatomy
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lengthened Stride
entries: Your {@rule Speed} increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Resilient Anatomy
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on saving throws against effects that would compel you to shape-shift against your will. Additionally, when you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Treacherous Allure
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enchanting Presence
entries: You always have the {@spell Charm Person} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot, and you must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

entries.name: Inevitable Betrayal
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on attack rolls against creatures with the {@condition Charmed} condition.

name: Tyro of the Gauntlet
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Stand as One
entries: When an ally within 5 feet of you is subjected to an effect that would push or pull it, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to prevent that ally from being pushed or pulled. To receive this benefit, the ally can't have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition.

entries.name: Vigilant
entries: When you take the {@action Ready} action, the next attack roll made against you has {@rule Disadvantage} before the start of your next turn.

name: Vampire Hunter
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Adroit Escape
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on checks to escape from nonmagical restraints or the {@condition Grappled} condition.

entries.name: Vitality Ward
entries: When you take Necrotic damage, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to mitigate the damage. Roll a number of d6s equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and add them together. Reduce the Necrotic damage you take by this total. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@rule Short Rest|Short} or {@rule Long Rest}.

name: Vampire Touched
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Vampire Magic
entries: Choose one level 1 spell from the Enchantment or Illusion school of magic. You always have that spell and the {@spell Spider Climb} spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot, but when you cast {@spell Spider Climb} this way, you must target yourself, and you must finish a {@rule Long Rest} before you can cast each spell in this way again. You can also cast either spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spells is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Vampire's Plaything
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Decanting
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can create one {@item Potion of Healing} or an {@item Antitoxin}, as long as you have an empty {@item vial} or {@item flask}. These liquids evaporate when you finish another {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Timely Retreat
entries: You can take a {@rule Bonus Action} to take the {@action Dash} action or the {@action Disengage} action. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}, and you recover all expended uses when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}.

entries.name: Vampiric Connection
entries: The DM determines the fate of your former vampire master. While you and your former vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with you telepathically, and you can choose to allow the vampire to perceive through your senses.

name: Vigor of the Hill Giant
entries: You've manifested the resilience emblematic of hill giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Bulwark
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that would move you at least 5 feet or give you the prone condition, you can use your reaction to steady yourself. You aren't moved and don't have the prone condition.

items.name: Iron Stomach
entries: Whenever you eat food as part of a short rest and spend one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points, you regain additional hit points equal to your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus.

name: War Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Concentration
entries: You have {@rule Advantage} on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain {@status Concentration}.

entries.name: Reactive Spell
entries: When a creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack} from you by leaving your reach, you can take a {@rule Reaction} to cast a spell at the creature rather than making an {@action Opportunity Attack}. The spell must have a casting time of one action and must target only that creature.

entries.name: Somatic Components
entries: You can perform the Somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a {@item Shield} in one or both hands.

name: Warlike Familiar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Battle Familiar
entries: You always have the {@spell Battle Familiar} spell (see chapter 2) prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@rule Long Rest}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the one chosen for the Faithful Companion benefit of your Familiar Friend feat.

entries.name: Intercept Attack
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of your familiar is hit by an attack roll, your familiar can take a {@rule Reaction} to add a bonus to the creature's {@rule Armor Class} against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss. The bonus is equal to your {@rule Proficiency|Proficiency Bonus}.

name: Weapon Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mastery Property
entries: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, provided you have proficiency with it. Whenever you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, you can change the kind of weapon to another eligible kind.

name: Will to Survive
entries: When you have the {@condition Incapacitated} condition but not the {@condition Unconscious} condition, you can draw on the proud heritage of Stormwind or Stromgarde to ignore the {@condition Incapacitated} condition on your turn. If you do, you gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion} level.

name: Wood Elf Magic
entries: You learn the magic of the primeval woods, which are revered and protected by your people. You learn one druid cantrip of your choice. You also learn the {@spell longstrider} and {@spell pass without trace} spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Zhentarim Ruffian
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Exploit Opening
entries: When you roll damage for an {@action Opportunity Attack}, you can roll the damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

entries.name: Family First
entries: If you have {@rule Heroic Inspiration} when you roll {@rule Initiative}, you can expend it to give yourself and your allies {@rule Advantage} on that {@rule Initiative} roll.

name: Zhentarim Tactics
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Retaliate
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack} against that creature.

entries.name: Versatile Merc
entries: When you finish a {@rule Long Rest}, choose a skill in which you have proficiency. You have {@rule Expertise} in that skill until you finish your next {@rule Long Rest}.
